evals.prompt: The streak card on HomeScreen feels static and boring. Make the streak number animate counting up when the screen first loads, and add a special visual treatment when the streak hits 7+ days.
evals.expected_output: Modified StreakCard composable in HomeScreen.kt using animateIntAsState for the count-up animation and conditional styling for high streaks.

evals.prompt: The character counter in the journal editor shows '45/120' but gives no visual warning as the user approaches the limit. Make it change colour and add a subtle shake animation when they're down to 10 characters left.
evals.expected_output: Modified JournalEditorCard in HomeScreen.kt with animateColorAsState for the counter text and a keyframes shake animation near the limit.

evals.prompt: The history screen just dumps all entries in a flat list with raw dates like '2026-10-08'. Group entries by month with sticky section headers, format dates as human-readable (e.g. 'Wed, Oct 8'), and add a smooth staggered animation when entries load.
evals.expected_output: Modified HistoryScreen.kt with LazyColumn stickyHeader blocks grouped by YearMonth, human-readable date formatting, and animateItem() on cards.
